title: drymocallis glandulosa var. wrangelliana
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa var. wrangelliana, commonly known as Wrangell's dryad root or Wrangell's dryad, is a plant species within the rose family native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic to alleviate muscle cramps. The therapeutic actions of Wrangell's dryad root include its ability to exert anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential as a treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
